title: Chapter 1474 - 14: An Ant Beholds The Heavens (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 1474 - 14: An Ant Beholds The Heavens (Part 2)

Chapter 1474: Chapter 14: An Ant Beholds the Heavens (Part 2)

Breaking through in the midst of battle? It might happen when one is weak, but for terrifying entities approaching the end of the path to transcendence, it is indeed a fantasy.

Lin Yuan stood there quietly; at this moment, his physique had become unimaginably strong, able to withstand the combined lethal strikes of over five hundred terrifying entities and more than ten thousand Legendary Lords with merely his physical body, without resorting to any means.

"Are you ready to die?" Lin Yuan opened his eyes, looking at the over five hundred terrifying entities and more than ten thousand Legendary Lords.

"Hahahaha..." The terrifying entity releasing infinite brightness laughed, also gazing at Lin Yuan: "Galaxy Lord, we have underestimated you. You actually concealed such a defense mechanism."

"I admit that in terms of defense, Galaxy Lord, you are unparalleled across all eras of infinite dimensional space, unmatched by any Legendary Lord."

Seriously said the terrifying entity releasing infinite brightness.

"But that’s all there is to it." The terrifying entity releasing infinite brightness shook his head: "A strong defense doesn’t mean you can kill us, not to mention that we possess countless means to preserve our lives; past and future across countless timespaces have backup plans, as long as there are beings who remember our names, we are considered immortal. What can you use to kill us?"

For over five hundred terrifying entities, besides the Supreme Rule Dao’s will personally erasing them, they truly didn’t know how they could die.

Even the ’Infinite Origin’ path to transcendence posed no great risk to them; the most difficult part was not knowing where the true time origin lies.

Lin Yuan looked at the numerous entities, a faint imprint emerged on his brow.

The essence of the imprint was a new Dao born from the fusion of five Chaotic Origin Daos, which Lin Yuan tried to activate, seeing an invisible energy spread with him as the center, extending in all directions.

The spread of the energy instantly shattered the heavily layered prison formed by over five hundred terrifying entities.

Bang bang bang~~~ The prison collapsed, and over five hundred terrifying entities finally directly felt the permeating and expanding invisible energy.

"What is this?"

The pupils of the terrifying entity releasing infinite brightness contracted; at this moment, he felt an unprecedented sense of oppression, and his mind involuntarily suffocated and trembled.

"Can’t withstand it, definitely can’t withstand it."

The terrifying entity releasing infinite brightness widened his eyes, instinctively knowing that the invisible energy was absolutely unstoppable.

"How is this possible?"

"How is this possible?"

In disbelief, the terrifying entity releasing infinite brightness didn’t have time to think further and directly exploded, transforming into rays of light fleeing in all directions.

Since it couldn’t be stopped, he wouldn’t try, but instead avoid it from afar.

How sharp the eyesight of the other terrifying entities was, they similarly sensed something amiss and immediately began retreating rapidly to escape.

Further away, the more than ten thousand current timespace’s Legendary Lords couldn’t escape in time, as nearly a thousand of them were immediately touched by the invisible energy.

"Ah ah ah?!!"

A two-horned Legendary Lord of two hundred million tribulations showed a look of horror as, under the sweep of the invisible energy, his physical body, soul, mind, and will began to be annihilated without suspense.

If it were only thus, this Legendary Lord wouldn’t be so terrified, but as the invisible energy spread, his past self, future self, life-preserving means along various timelines, and even traces of his existence began to be obliterated.

And once all traces related to him are erased, it would mean complete and thorough death, with no chance of resurrection.

How could this not terrify this Legendary Lord?

"Galaxy Lord, I was wrong, I was wrong..."

The invisible energy continued to spread, and the pleading of the horned Legendary Lord was abruptly cut off, being completely erased.

"Galaxy Lord!"

The terrifying entity releasing infinite brightness appeared again, looking at the spot where the horned Legendary Lord was annihilated, likewise realizing that the opponent had indeed completely died and fallen.

Although the horned Legendary Lord had only undergone two hundred million tribulations, to be completely fallen? Only the Supreme Rule Dao’s will could accomplish it.

Even if he personally made a move, at most, he could only kill several main combat physical bodies of the opponent, far from being able to completely kill the opponent.

But now, the horned Legendary Lord had indeed completely fallen.

"Have you transcended?"

The terrifying entity releasing infinite brightness asked in a deep voice.

At this moment, Lin Yuan’s methods had completely surpassed his understanding, with a casual strike, he could completely kill a Legendary Lord of two hundred million tribulations?

"Far from transcendence."

Lin Yuan gently shook his head, then looked at the five hundred plus silhouettes including the terrifying entity releasing infinite brightness: "It’s your turn."

Boom!

The invisible energy suddenly enveloped them, leaving the terrifying entity releasing infinite brightness with no choice but to withstand it.

"Not transcended?"

Upon contact with the invisible energy, in mere moments, the terrifying entity releasing infinite brightness found that more than forty percent of his past selves and future selves along various timelines had their means completely annihilated.

"Leave."

"Everyone leave."

"Return to your respective timespaces."

The terrifying entity releasing infinite brightness immediately shuddered with fear, although he hadn’t completely fallen like the horned Legendary Lord.

But after erasing more than forty percent of traces along past and future timelines, if Lin Yuan made two or three more moves, he would be no different from the horned Legendary Lord.

"Return to respective timespaces?"

Over five hundred terrifying entities immediately understood the meaning of the words.

They were not lifeforms of the current timespace; as long as they returned to their respective timespaces, Lin Yuan would have to follow them to kill them.
